description: City-owned simulation and rendering composition. OSM parsing remains outside this contract because geo-analysis/moenarch-geo-io-osm owns source parsing; city-game budgets canonical scenario/save semantics after that seam.

scenarios.description: Advance the canonical demo save through 10,000 fixed simulation steps from an identical initial save. The clock batch itself is constant-work and must not rescan immutable building capacity.
correctnessEvidence: byte-identical final save across repeated runs
one clock write for a non-zero batch regardless of step count
zero immutable-building capacity visits during fixed-step advancement

metrics.name: tick_writes_per_batch
metrics.notes: Thread-local test instrumentation requires exactly one authoritative clock commit for any non-zero batch and zero for a zero-step batch.

metrics.name: population_building_visits_per_advance
metrics.notes: Validated immutable scenario building capacity may not be recomputed merely to advance time. Future capacity-changing systems must validate at their mutation boundary.

metrics.name: legacy_to_candidate_speedup
metrics.notes: Cargo-native advisory benchmark compares the candidate against the previous work pattern: per-call rules validation, population-capacity scan, and iterative clock advancement.
